units.source_text: 那里有一户磨圆木的人家。

en.t: There was a household there that polished round logs.

units.source_text: 女人们把泡在水面的圆木拿起来，用菩提瀑布的沙子细心地磨着。

en.t: The women lifted the round logs soaking on the surface of the water and carefully polished them with sand from Bodhi Falls.

units.source_text: 这种沙子是红色的，像黏土一样。

en.t: This sand was red, like clay.

units.source_text: 据说是从菩提瀑布的下游取来的。

en.t: It was said to have been taken from downstream of Bodhi Falls.
